description: Paid routes require a funded Base USDC wallet. Use readfetch-client / @readfetch/client or the MCP signing proxy (@readfetch/mcp-x402-proxy). Direct calls without a signing client will stop at 402. Discover a site's crawlable surface without crawling it: parse robots.txt allow/disallow rules, collect URLs from sitemap.xml and sitemap indexes, find RSS, Atom and JSON feeds, and count internal and external links on the homepage. Use the returned URLs to plan readfetch_scrape, readfetch_batch, or readfetch_crawl — not readfetch_map again on each URL. Prefer readfetch_probe on one URL before paying for bodies.

limit.description: Maximum number of URLs to return (1-1000).
limit.title: Limit

max_bytes.description: Abort if any single document exceeds this many bytes.
max_bytes.title: Max Bytes

timeout_s.description: Total budget for the whole call in seconds; every sitemap fetch and the browser fallback share it. 95 s is the edge ceiling (Cloudflare closes at 100 s).
timeout_s.title: Timeout S

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the site to map.
url.title: Url
